label: Clipping the step
subgoals: Compare the proposed update with the clip limit
Apply the update with its magnitude capped at the limit
Keep the sign of the proposed update

label: Uniform damping of a vector update
section: Uniform damping of a vector update
subgoals: Find the largest magnitude in the update vector
Set alpha to the limit over that magnitude, capped at one
Scale every component of the update by alpha

label: Backtracking on the residual
subgoals: Evaluate the residual at the full Newton step
Halve alpha until the sufficient-decrease test passes
Accept the first alpha that passes
